scope: Proposition 5.3 of the manuscript “The Kirchberg–Rørdam character criterion” (preprints/The-Kirchberg-Rordam-character-criterion-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 299 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 a0e2d22982358ba1), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 16. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let P be a nonzero unital C∗-algebra. Suppose that there is a unital ∗- homomorphism η : C → P such that η(ιe11) is full in P. Then, for some finite m ≥ 1, the maximal tensor power B = P⊗m contains orthogonal positive contractions b1, b2 and an element vB such that b1 = v∗ BvB, b2 = vBv∗ B, 1B − b1 − b2 ≾ (b1 − 1/2)+. Consequently there is a unital ∗-homomorphism I(2, 3) −→ P⊗m .
